candidates.change_summary: Replace the transfer of the contract's entire balance with a transfer of 1 wei so the amount sent differs.
Change the divisor in the block number condition from 15 to 16, altering when the transfer occurs.
Remove the timestamp check, allowing the fallback to be called in the same block, changing pastBlockTime updates and possible transfer frequency.
Remove the msg.value requirement so fallback can be called with any amount or plain Ether transfers, changing when pastBlockTime is updated and transfers happen.
Insert a selfdestruct to sender right after the transfer, changing contract state after call completes.
